collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SLR Class 2004 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz SLR Class Roadster 2004 Onwards (R199) model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Side Pin arm attachment.
